stories.title: S. Korea holds emergency security meeting after North Korea fires ballistic missiles

en.title: S. Korea holds emergency security meeting after North Korea fires ballistic missiles
en.summary: South Korea's National Security Office convened an emergency meeting with defense agencies after North Korea launched multiple short-range ballistic missiles from Wonsan toward the East Sea. The missiles traveled approximately 250 kilometers, with the launch detected around 5:20 a.m.

en.title: Seoul shares dip 1.76% on rising oil prices, inflation woes
